description: Assign Oilcan 1, Polyperc 1 and Doubledecker to channels 1, 2 and 3. Repeat the percussion and bass trigs in each bar. On channel 3, use MIDI 60 and 62 as chord roots in bars 1 to 3; change them to MIDI 67 and 60 in bar 4. Play the four-bar loop to hear the chord change over the repeated rhythm and bass. The example uses step masks within one sequence.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Rhythm, bass and a changing chord
